reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness theme collection that changes interface colors and supports persistent theme selection through browser local storage and plugin installation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供包含浅色和深色形态的多套界面主题，并支持保存主题选择。
summaries.en: Provides multiple light and dark interface themes for DeepSeek Harness with persistent theme selection.

capabilities: modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface theme and color tokens
provides light and dark theme variants
stores the selected theme in browser local storage
includes dynamic and persistent installation mechanisms
